description: Uitdagingen-curation (Wonen & Werken): de WN-03-les als variant, streng stedelijk-alleen en een uitbreidingsband.

scenarios.name: Detailhandel verbod executed over the whole object
scenarios.description: FR-WE-06 (art. 9.20) refuses detailhandel buiten bestaand winkelgebied but is sub-class-scoped (markers never eliminate area for bedrijventerreinen); this variant executes the over-broad reading that nullified the 9.16/9.18 openings in the pipeline's first run (WN-03 lesson) — now as an explicit scenario.

basis.provenanceNote: NC-WE-06 (art. 9.20) is sub-class-scoped to detailhandel; the over-broad area exclusion was re-adjudicated (WN-03). This variant makes that strict reading an explicit, visible policy choice.

scenarios.name: Business development only within existing urban area
scenarios.description: Drops FR-WE-03 (art. 9.16, uitbreiding bedrijventerrein onder voorwaarden, 703.4 km²) — companies remain limited to the stedelijk gebied opening (art. 9.18).

basis.provenanceNote: NC-WE-03 (art. 9.16) is the conditioned bedrijventerrein-uitbreiding exception; this variant documents dropping that lever (strictest anti-expansion reading).

scenarios.name: Bedrijventerrein designation expanded by a 500 m band
scenarios.description: Buffers the art. 9.16 inclusion (FR-WE-03) outward by 500 m — an expansion-band variant.

basis.rationale: The designation envelope is a programming area; a 500 m band is not cited anywhere — this hypothetical measures what it would add.
basis.provenanceNote: NOT legally grounded: the designation (NC-WE-03, art. 9.16) is cited, the 500 m band is the scenario's own parameter.
